Name: Quick Shortcut
Author: at0mato
Description:
[size=6]Quick Shortcut[/size]
A Stardew Valley mod that provides configurable keyboard shortcuts for common in-game actions, helping you play more efficiently.



[size=5]Features[/size]

[center][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/46132/46132-1778573851-300831317.png[/img][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Horse Summoner[/b][/size]
Instantly summon your horse from anywhere — no need to scroll through your inventory to find the Horse Flute.

- [b]Default key[/b]: "Left Shift"
- [b]Requires[/b]: Horse Flute in your inventory

[size=4][b]Quick Recall[/b][/size]
Warp home instantly using the Return Scepter with a single key press.

- [b]Default key:[/b] " ` " (Tilde / backtick)
- [b]Requires:[/b] Return Scepter in your inventory

[size=4][b]Quick Weapon[/b][/size]
Automatically switch to the strongest weapon in your inventory. No more scrolling through toolbar slots mid-combat.

- [b]Default key:[/b] "F"
- [b]Options:[/b] Choose between Melee weapons or Slingshots

[b][size=4]Zoom Control[/size][/b]
Fine-tune the camera zoom level using a modifier key + mouse scroll.

- [b]Default:[/b] "Left Shift" + Mouse Scroll
- [b]Range:[/b] 25% – 200% (configurable)
- [b]Step:[/b] 5% per scroll tick (configurable)

[b][size=4]Custom Item Binding[/size][/b]
Bind [b]any item[/b] in your inventory to a hotkey for instant access. Perfect for bombs, food, totems, floor tiles, and more.

- [b]Trigger key:[/b] "Left Alt" (switch to the bound item)
- [b]Bind key:[/b] "Left Ctrl + B" (bind the item you're currently holding)

[size=4]How it works[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Hold the item you want to bind (e.g., a Bomb)[/*]
[*]Press `Left Ctrl + B` — you'll see a confirmation message[/*]
[*]From now on, press `Left Alt` to instantly switch to that item[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Auto-Use behavior (enabled by default)[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Food / Drinks:[/b] Shows vanilla "Eat [item]?" confirmation dialog[/*]
[*][b]Totems, Horse Flute[/b]: Activates immediately[/*]
[*][b]Solid objects[/b] (machines, chests): Places at the tile your mouse is aiming at (within reach), one at a time[/*]
[*][b]Floor tiles, paths, grass[/b]: Places at your feet — **hold the key** to place continuously while walking[/*]
[*][b]Tools[/b]: Starts the tool swing animation[/*]
[/list]


[size=5]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for in-game config UI)[/*]
[*]Download the latest release and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]


[size=5]Compatibility [/size]

[b]Stardew Valley[/b]: 1.6+
[b]SMAPI[/b]: 4.0+
[b]Multiplayer[/b]: Not tested. Use at your own risk in multiplayer.
[b]Conflicts[/b]: None known. All keybinds are fully configurable to avoid conflicts with other mods.

[size=5]Languages[/size]
[list]
[*]English: ✅[/*]
[*]Tiếng Việt: ✅[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Changelog [/size]

[size=4]1.0.0 [/size]
- Initial release
- Horse Summoner — summon horse via Horse Flute
- Quick Recall — warp home via Return Scepter
- Quick Weapon — switch to best weapon (Melee or Slingshot)
- Zoom Control — modifier key + scroll to zoom
- Custom Item Binding — bind any inventory item to a hotkey
  - Auto-use with smart placement (cursor-aimed for solids, feet for floors)
  - Hold-to-place for continuous floor/path/grass placement
  - Vanilla confirmation dialog for food/drinks
- Full Generic Mod Config Menu integration
- English and Vietnamese localization
